## Body

For documentation that publishes live-fleet receipts, inspect the entire changed documents, not just added lines or familiar token prefixes. Distinguish configuration path references from credential contents, environment-variable names from session values, generic service hosts from tenant-specific routing, and public handles from authentication material. Prior publication establishes context, not permission for new disclosure.

The operational local-path checker can exclude all receipt/PRD/workstream documents. Report that exclusion honestly; when its pure scanText API is available, apply it directly to the reviewed documents without broadening the repository check or reading live configuration. Keep the scoped result distinct from running the full recipe.

Across wording-only review-head changes, verify the complete incremental diff and compare every reviewed worktree blob to the new commit. Carry forward retained inspection only for byte-identical content, and bind the published verdict to the final full SHA. A static security PASS is not merge readiness: record any unsuccessful pr-freeze and pending checks explicitly rather than calling the head final.

Magic wand: a read-only review-proof command should collect exact-head finality, CI state, scoped public-data scans and proof exclusions without building. It should also reject delegated reports that omit the baseline file inventory, scan results, file:line evidence or proof limits; an incremental report cannot substantiate a verdict-only baseline.

Evidence: PR 242 at ef6bcc313b284f02c881e00f8e091229a309cb69; docs/plans/004-acceptance/receipts.md:16,20,30-31,34,37,41,43-45,49-52. The retained delegated review covered five full documents and verified blob identity across two replacement heads; local-path scanText found no home paths even though the documents were excluded by shouldScanFile. No builds or credential reads were performed.
